stories.title: Judge throws out DOE’s blanket ‘still interested’ FOIA policy
stories.why: The Energy Department tried to use a mass "still interested" notice to close older FOIA requests.

stories.title: Mediation agency changes how labor disputes move forward
stories.why: The Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service says it is clarifying when it can decline to provide arbitrators, a change unions say exceeds its role.

stories.title: DoD pulls independent testing office’s public reports from its website
stories.why: “The transition of DOT&E materials to a CAC-enabled environment is a proactive measure to strengthen our operational security posture,” a DoD official said.

stories.title: Snowflake hacker pleads guilty, faces up to 32 years in prison
stories.why: Connor Moucka obtained almost $500,000 for playing a key role in one of the most widespread and damaging cyberattack sprees on record.

stories.title: Agencies told to prioritize hiring early-career employees, tech talent
stories.why: The hiring efforts diverge from an earlier push to reduce the size of the federal workforce, leading to hundreds of thousands of feds leaving their jobs.

stories.title: First Trump-class battleship could cost more than $23B: CBO
stories.why: The Congressional Budget Office estimates that 15 nuclear-powered battleships would cost $275 billion.
